title: Six Creative Commons Licenses Poster
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Explore a poster of the six Creative Commons licenses, then click the panel that matches each of six descriptions.

learningObjectives: The learner will identify which of the six Creative Commons licenses matches each of six descriptions, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The six licenses CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC, CC BY-NC-SA, CC BY-ND, and CC BY-NC-ND

dependencies: None. The drawing is inline SVG and the script is plain JavaScript.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: Which elements does this license combine?
Which freedom does each element take away?
assessmentOpportunities: Which license allows commercial use but forbids sharing changed versions?
Which license puts no condition on the work beyond credit?
Which license text does Wikipedia use?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz me buttons
controls.description: switch modes. Quiz me starts a new run.

controls.name: The six panels
controls.description: hover, focus with the Tab key, or click. In quiz mode a click is your answer.
